I wrote `shipping_fee(weight_g, distance_km, express)` in `solve.py` in the current folder. All 11 sample cases I checked match hand-calculated values, and the out-of-range inputs raise `ValueError`.

Two choices I made where the spec was open:
- **Rounding:** the fee is rounded to the nearest satang, with halves rounded up. For example, 5,001 g gives 8,001.5 satang, which becomes 8,002.
- **Boundaries:** the 100 km surcharge applies only when distance is strictly greater than 100. Weight above 5,000 g is charged pro-rata, so fractional kilograms are allowed.

The calculation uses `Fraction` throughout, so float error doesn't affect the satang result. There was no `./skills` folder, so there were no skill instructions to follow.
